proof_body:
by
  intro a M h
  have hbdd : ∀ n, BddAbove (a '' Set.Ici n) := fun n =>
    ⟨M, by
      rintro _ ⟨k, _, rfl⟩
      exact (le_abs_self _).trans (h k)⟩
  have hb : Filter.IsBoundedUnder (· ≤ ·) Filter.atTop a :=
    Filter.isBoundedUnder_of ⟨M, fun n => (le_abs_self _).trans (h n)⟩
  have hb' : Filter.IsBoundedUnder (· ≥ ·) Filter.atTop a :=
    Filter.isBoundedUnder_of ⟨-M, fun n => (abs_le.1 (h n)).1⟩
  constructor
  · intro m n hmn
    refine csSup_le_csSup (hbdd m) ⟨a n, n, Set.mem_Ici.2 le_rfl, rfl⟩ ?_
    rintro _ ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨k, Set.mem_Ici.2 (hmn.trans hk), rfl⟩
  · refine Metric.tendsto_atTop.2 fun ε hε => ?_
    have h1 : ∀ᶠ n in Filter.atTop, a n < Filter.limsup a Filter.atTop + ε / 2 :=
      Filter.eventually_lt_of_limsup_lt (by linarith) hb
    obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.1 h1
    refine ⟨K, fun n hn => ?_⟩
    have hup : sSup (a '' Set.Ici n) ≤ Filter.limsup a Filter.atTop + ε / 2 := by
      refine csSup_le ⟨a n, n, Set.mem_Ici.2 le_rfl, rfl⟩ ?_
      rintro _ ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩
      exact (hK k (hn.trans hk)).le
    have hlow : Filter.limsup a Filter.atTop - ε / 2 < sSup (a '' Set.Ici n) := by
      have h2 : ∃ᶠ k in Filter.atTop, Filter.limsup a Filter.atTop - ε / 2 < a k :=
        Filter.frequently_lt_of_lt_limsup hb'.isCoboundedUnder_le (by linarith)
      obtain ⟨k, hk, hk2⟩ := Filter.frequently_atTop.1 h2 n
      exact hk2.trans_le (le_csSup (hbdd n) ⟨k, Set.mem_Ici.2 hk, rfl⟩)
    rw [Real.dist_eq, abs_lt]
    constructor <;> linarith
target_source: ∀ (a : ℕ → ℝ) (M : ℝ), (∀ n, |a n| ≤ M) → Antitone (fun n => sSup (a '' Set.Ici n)) ∧ Filter.Tendsto (fun n => sSup (a '' Set.Ici n)) Filter.atTop (nhds (Filter.limsup a Filter.atTop))
